query: 'SELECT
    t.ci,
    s.nombres + ' ' + ISNULL(s.ap_paterno,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(s.ap_materno,'') AS nombre_completo,
    s.fecha_nac,
    s.genero,
    s.estado_civil,
    s.municipio,
    CASE WHEN s.fecha_nac IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, s.fecha_nac, GETDATE()) ELSE NULL END AS edad_actual,
    CASE WHEN s.ci IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tiene_datos_segip
FROM (
    SELECT ci_beneficiaria AS ci FROM silver.bja_inscripciones
    UNION SELECT ci_beneficiaria FROM silver.bja_controles_prenatales
    UNION SELECT ci_madre FROM silver.bja_partos
    UNION SELECT ci_recien_nacido FROM silver.bja_partos WHERE ci_recien_nacido IS NOT NULL
    UNION SELECT ci_nino FROM silver.bja_controles_pediatricos
    UNION SELECT ci_madre FROM silver.bja_controles_pediatricos
    UNION SELECT ci_beneficiaria FROM silver.bja_pagos
    UNION SELECT ci_beneficiaria FROM silver.sup_inscripciones
    UNION SELECT ci_beneficiaria FROM silver.sup_controles
    UNION SELECT ci_beneficiaria FROM silver.sup_boletas
    UNION SELECT ci_beneficiaria FROM silver.sup_entregas_paquetes
) AS t
LEFT JOIN silver.segip_personas s
    ON t.ci = s.ci',
